control.description-key: PDF Viewer PCF control using Mozilla pdf.js

property.name: PdfSource
property.description-key: Base64 encoded PDF, data URI, or document URL

property.name: Zoom
property.description-key: Zoom mode (page-width, page-fit, auto) or scale factor

property.name: GoToPage
property.description-key: Target page number to navigate to

property.name: Password
property.description-key: Password for encrypted PDFs

property.name: ShowToolbar
property.description-key: Whether to display the navigation toolbar

property.name: AllowDownload
property.description-key: Whether to allow downloading the PDF

property.name: ShowHighlight
property.description-key: Whether to show the Highlight button

property.name: DisplayModeHighlight
property.description-key: DisplayMode for Highlight: Edit, View, or Disabled

property.name: ShowDraw
property.description-key: Whether to show the Draw ink annotation button

property.name: DisplayModeDraw
property.description-key: DisplayMode for Draw: Edit, View, or Disabled

property.name: ShowText
property.description-key: Whether to show the Add text comment button

property.name: DisplayModeText
property.description-key: DisplayMode for Text Comment: Edit, View, or Disabled

property.name: ShowStamp
property.description-key: Whether to show the Add or edit images button

property.name: DisplayModeStamp
property.description-key: DisplayMode for Images: Edit, View, or Disabled

property.name: ShowPrint
property.description-key: Whether to show the Print PDF button

property.name: DisplayModePrint
property.description-key: DisplayMode for Print: Edit, View, or Disabled

property.name: ShowDownload
property.description-key: Whether to show the Download PDF button

property.name: DisplayModeDownload
property.description-key: DisplayMode for Download: Edit, View, or Disabled

property.name: LoadStatus
property.description-key: Status of PDF loading (Idle, Loading, Loaded, Error)

property.name: ErrorMessage
property.description-key: Details of the last encountered error, if any

property.name: EditedPdf
property.description-key: Base64 encoded string of the edited PDF document, including all annotations and edits
